review_notes:
I read the whole file. I checked the main candidates for a competing version of an existing concept. These were `mapHopfIdealPointsSubgroup`, `mapHopfIdealPointsSubgroupCongr` and `hopfIdealPointsSubgroup`.

- `mapHopfIdealPointsSubgroup` is built from `MonoidHom.domRestrict` and `codRestrict` applied to `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map`. It is a named specialisation over existing operations, not a rival concept.
- `mapHopfIdealPointsSubgroupCongr` uses `MonoidHom.subgroupCongr`. Mathlib has no `MonoidHom.subgroupCongr`; the only definition is in the library's own `TauCeti/Algebra/Group/Subgroup/Map.lean`, and it is built on Mathlib's `MulEquiv.subgroupCongr`. So the file reuses Mathlib here.
- `hopfIdealPointsSubgroup` is defined as `Subgroup.map` of the existing `CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroup` along `pointsMulEquiv`. This is a transport of an existing object, not a parallel one.

I found no independent Mathlib declaration that this file duplicates. My Mathlib searches were targeted greps, not an exhaustive survey.
